newsitem.title: USA: Transcend sees margin improvements holding.
newsitem.headline: Transcend sees margin improvements holding.

text.p: Transcend Services Inc said Monday it expects sales to increase and margin improvements to hold firm for the rest of the year.
The company reported its first quarter loss narrowed to $0.01 a share from $0.04 a year earlier. Revenues rose to $9,958,000 from $8,688,000.

The company, which handles health information management systems for hospitals, said it experienced gross margin improvement in three of its four business units in the first quarter, compared to a year earlier.
"We look for our sales activity to increase and for the margin improvement we have experienced to hold firm in the second quarter and throughout 1997," Transcend said in a statement.
It said it was disappointed by its inability to close a new contract in the first quarter.
